To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“a human touch can be used to browse the real world”.
“we are able to browse the real world with our bare hands using organic electronics, Si‐chips, and a human touch”.

we have demonstrated that it is possible to use organic electronics, silicon chips, and a human hand to create an interactive and intelligent platform that can be used for the browsing of the real world.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new generation of organic electronics and bioelectronics that can be used to create a personalized web, i.e., an individual web, that will be a natural extension of the Internet.
the development of a body network that will enable a new generation of applications that are both more personal and more powerful.
the design of a new generation of organic‐silicon chips that can be integrated with organic‐based sensors and actuators to form a new generation of body networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the future will be a fusion of organic and inorganic electronics, and that we will be able to browse the real world using organic electronics, silicon‐chips, and a human touch.
the organic electronics and the silicon chips are the two complementary and necessary ingredients for the realization of the body network.
the future of the organic electronics is bright, but not as expected.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are developing a new paradigm for the Internet of Things, i.e., the body network, where our body becomes the browser of the real world, and our hand is the interface between our brain and the world around us, with the potential to change the way we live, work, and play.
the organic electronics can be used to create an organic brain that is connected to the silicon‐chip brain.
organic electronics can be used to create a personalized web, where our body is a network, our hands are browsers, and our brain is the search engine.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a combination of the traditional integrated silicon chips and organic electronics, together with the human body, is an enabling technology for the realization of the “internet of things’’.
organic electronics can be integrated with traditional silicon chips to form a new platform that will enable a new generation of personalized web‐based services.
a new generation of mobile devices and sensors will be developed, where the human body is the natural platform, the skin the natural interface, and the cloud the natural data storage.
